instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to complete the paragraph.

atoms.a: Barney put the egg box on the side of the worktop. Paisley, his younger sister ran towards the worktop. She hadn’t seen the eggs.
atoms.b: The box fell to the ground, coating the kitchen floor in egg.

atoms.a: Doris carried her box of clothes all the way to the charity shop. Outside the charity shop, there was a large puddle on a busy road. As Doris walked towards the shop door, a large car sped towards the puddle.
atoms.b: The box was soaked as the large car drove through the puddle.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to complete the paragraph.

atoms.a: Toby went to the shop to buy a water bottle. Later that day, he went for a run, and he took the water bottle with him. As he was running, the water bottle fell out of his bag onto the hard ground.
atoms.b: The water bottle cracked and sprayed water everywhere.

atoms.a: Kareem tries to live sustainably. He always takes a reusable water bottle to university with him. Yesterday, he left his water bottle in a lecture hall.
atoms.b: The water bottle was picked up and taken to lost property.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to complete the paragraph.

atoms.a: Juan usually gets to school on time, but he accidentally set his alarm too late.
atoms.b: When the alarm finally went off, he jumped out of bed and ran all the way to school.

atoms.a: Robert enjoys baking. Yesterday he baked a chocolate sponge cake. He baked the cake for exactly 45 minutes and used an alarm to keep track of the time.
atoms.b: When the alarm went off, he jumped up from the sofa and walked to the oven to take the cake out.
